name: Gorgon, Aeetos
body:
Aeetos
CR 5

This bull-like creature seems to be made of interlocking metallic scales and plates, with glowing embers for eyes and smoke trailing up from its mouth.

XP 1,600
N Large magical beast (fire)
Init +0; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +9; Aura forge heat (5 ft., 1d6 fire)

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 9, flat-footed 17 (+8 natural, –1 size)
hp 46 (5d10+20)
Fort +9, Ref +4, Will +4
Immune fire; Weaknesses vulnerable to cold

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee gore +9 (2d8+5), 2 hooves +4 (1d6+2)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks breath weapon (30-foot cone, 5d6 fire, DC 17, usable every 1d4 rounds), burning stampede, trample (1d6+7 plus 1d6 fire, DC 17)

STATISTICS

Str 21, Dex 11, Con 20, Int 2, Wis 12, Cha 5
Base Atk +5; CMB +11 (+13 bull rush); CMD 21 (23 vs. bull rush, 25 vs. trip)
Feats Improved Bull Rush, Iron Will, Power Attack
Skills Perception +9

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Burning Stampede (Su)

When an aeetos uses its trample ability, all squares it passes through burst into flame as it moves. These flames persist until the beginning of the aeetos’ next turn and then go out. Creatures entering or beginning their turn in the burning area take 1d6 points of fire damage.

If an aeetos using its trample ability has a Large or larger creature in its path, it can move up to the edge of that creature’s space and smash into it, dealing its trample damage and making a bull rush combat maneuver as a free action, moving along with the target on a successful check.

Forge Heat (Su)

Creatures entering or beginning their turn within 5 feet of an aeetos take 1d6 points of fire damage.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate plains, rocky hills, and underground
Organization solitary, pair, pack (3–4), or herd (5–12)
Treasure none

While the hide of most gorgons resembles dull iron, that of the aeetos is like burnished bronze. These brazen bulls radiate an inner heat, some say sparked within them from the forges of an ancient god who crafted them from ingots before he breathed life into them and set them loose on the world as a gift to a mighty king. Unlike other gorgons, an aeetos can digest metal after reducing it to slag in their gullets.
